question: Retrieve distinct case references, case numbers, investigation numbers, and clone information where a single clone simultaneously exhibits all three of the following genetic alterations: (1) a loss on chromosome 13 between positions 48,303,751 and 48,481,890, (2) a loss on chromosome 17 between positions 7,668,421 and 7,687,490, and (3) a gain on chromosome 11 between positions 108,223,067 and 108,369,102. For each matching clone, display the chromosomal details for each of these three regions (including chromosome number represented by ChrOrd, start position, and end position) and the corresponding karyotype short description from the KaryClone table. Use the CytoConverted and KaryClone.
sql:
WITH region1 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 48481890 AND `End` > 48303751
),
region2 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 7687490 AND `End` > 7668421
),
region3 AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start < 108369102 AND `End` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r1.RefNo, r1.CaseNo, r1.InvNo, r1.Clone
  FROM region1 r1
  JOIN region2 r2 ON r1.RefNo = r2.RefNo AND r1.CaseNo = r2.CaseNo AND r1.InvNo = r2.InvNo AND r1.Clone = r2.Clone
  JOIN region3 r3 ON r1.RefNo = r3.RefNo AND r1.CaseNo = r3.CaseNo AND r1.InvNo = r3.InvNo AND r1.Clone = r3.Clone
)
SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
       c13.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd_13, c13.Start AS Start_13, c13.`End` AS End_13,
       c17.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd_17, c17.Start AS Start_17, c17.`End` AS End_17,
       c11.ChrOrd AS ChrOrd_11, c11.Start AS Start_11, c11.`End` AS End_11,
       kc.CloneShort
FROM matching_clones mc
JOIN region1 c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone AND c13.rn = 1
JOIN region2 c17 ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone AND c17.rn = 1
JOIN region3 c11 ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone AND c11.rn = 1
JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone
